description: Remove unwanted objects from images by describing what to remove — no mask needed. Combines Grounding DINO detection (ECCV 2024) with Bria Eraser inpainting. Just say 'person', 'car', or 'watermark' and the object is erased and filled convincingly. 130 sats per image, pay per request with Bitcoin Lightning — no API key or signup needed. Requires create_payment with toolName='remove_object'.
